# VYBE2K26

> VYBE2K26 (also written VYBE 2K26) is the inter-college fest of KLE Society's Degree College, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru - 560072, Karnataka, India. Competitions run on 4 and 5 November 2026, followed by a live concert by Rajesh Krishnan on 6 November 2026 at 6:00 PM.

- Website: https://www.vybe2k26.com/
- Venue: KLE Society's Degree College, Opposite BDA Complex, Nagarbhavi, Bengaluru - 560072
- Dates: 4-6 November 2026
- Registration: each competition has its own registration form, linked from the Register button for that event on the website. Fees are paid by UPI and are non-refundable.
- Concert tickets: Rajesh Krishnan Live in Concert, 6 November 2026, 6:00 PM, on BookMyShow from Rs 499: https://in.bookmyshow.com/events/rajesh-krishnan-live-in-concert-bengaluru/ET00522582
- Contact: +91 93539 85382, +91 86607 36466, +91 80889 47005, vybe2k26@klenagarbhavi.edu.in
- Eligibility: students of any college with a valid college ID card; in group events all team members must be from the same college (unless the event rules say otherwise); up to three teams per college per event.

## Competitions

### Technical
- Tech Treasure Hunt: 4 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM, PU Basement Lab; team: 2–3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 200 per team
- Code Relay: 4 Nov 2026, 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM, Computer Laboratories (PB1, PB2, and PB3); team: 3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 200 per team
- Live Deploy Race: 5 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM, PU Basement Lab; team: 2 members per team; entry fee: Rs 200 per team
- Gen AI Cinema: 4 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM, 3rd Floor, BCA Department (LH-1); team: 1–3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 100 per participant
- De_Code: 5 Nov 2026, 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM, PU Basement Lab; team: 2–3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 200 per team
- Tech Arena: 5 Nov 2026, 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM, PU Basement Lab; team: 2–3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 200 per team

### Cultural
- Group Dance: 4 Nov 2026, 10:30 AM onwards, Auditorium; team: Minimum 4 participants per team; entry fee: Rs 1,000 per team
- Solo Dance: 4 Nov 2026, 10:30 AM onwards, Auditorium; team: Individual; entry fee: Rs 300 per participant
- Group Singing: 5 Nov 2026, 10:00 AM onwards, Auditorium; team: Minimum 3 participants per team; entry fee: Rs 400 per team
- Solo Singing: 5 Nov 2026, 10:00 AM onwards, Auditorium; team: Individual; entry fee: Rs 200 per participant
- Fashion Show: 5 Nov 2026, 12:30 PM onwards, Auditorium; team: Minimum 6 participants per team; entry fee: Rs 2,000 per team

### Management

- Best Manager: 5 Nov 2026, 10:00 AM, 2nd Floor, BBA Department (Room No: LHS - 2); team: Individual; entry fee: Rs 300 per participant

- Scary House: 4 & 5 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM, LH B1 and B2; team: 3 members per team; entry fee: Rs 300 per team of 3
- Biz-Quiz: 4 Nov 2026, 11:00 AM, LH G2 and LH F6; team: 2 members per team; entry fee: Rs 500 per team
